**Texere – The Researcher's Vault 0.4.21** · 13 November 2026

The ready-made Obsidian vault: download **Texere-vault-0.4.21.zip** below, unzip it and open the folder in Obsidian (**Open folder as vault**, then **Trust author and enable plugins**).

- **Texere 0.4.21** inside. The setup does everything for you, one step at a time: folders, bibliography and citation styles, templates and writing guides, the map of philosophy (with its fields in your reading notes) and **PDF++**, installed and set up for Texere (colours as tags, auto-copy, auto-paste). **Focus mode** (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + D) leaves only the files you have open.
- **Cite straight from Zotero:** type @ and pick from your Zotero library too, no Better BibTeX needed; you choose whether only the reference comes in or its PDF too, with its annotations. In a PDF, the **pointer** (or H) lets you select text to follow your reading without copying it into the note.
- **Citations work from the start**; tags appear in their PDF++ colours; the home page shows your first steps and new versions as soon as they're out.
- **The map of philosophy:** about 430 linked notes (branches, subfields, periods, movements, theories, concepts, authors), with Romanian aliases.
- **Templates:** New essay, New author, and the BA and MA thesis templates of the Faculty of Philosophy, University of Bucharest; writing guides with their references.

The plugin's code and releases: [gorgmihai92/texere-plugin](https://github.com/gorgmihai92/texere-plugin).
